biggest_catch: Selective — identity/credential verification plus skills evaluation; project matching is never guaranteed.
catches: Onboarding includes identity verification, credential checks, and a skills evaluation — selective.
Project availability varies; matching to a project is never guaranteed.
Rates vary by domain and project complexity; entry-level rates are lower than the top tier.
Work is remote contract/project-based, not steady employment.
